title: Isolation method for human metaphase chromosomes
protocol: Maintain HeLa S3 cells in RPMI1640 medium supplemented with 5% FCS, 100 U/ml penicillin, and 100 μg/ml streptomycin.
Culture the cells to a total volume of 4 liters using ten flasks (400 ml per flask).
Add colcemid solution to achieve a final concentration of 0.1 μg/ml when cell density is 3-4 × 10^5 cells/ml.
Incubate the culture for 16 hours after adding colcemid.
Separate cells from flasks by tapping and pouring the 4 liters of culture into four centrifuge tubes (1 liter each).
Harvest cells by centrifugation at 1,500 × g and 4°C for 10 minutes in a JLA-9.1000 rotor.
Remove supernatant by decanting.
Resuspend the cells in 75 mM KCl solution.
Incubate the resuspended cells at room temperature (R.T.) for 30 minutes.
Centrifuge at 780 × g and 4°C for 10 minutes in a TS-38N rotor.
Remove supernatant by decanting.
Add 40 ml of ice-cold PA buffer per tube to resuspend the cells.
Take 40 ml of the solution and disrupt cell membrane with a Dounce homogenizer about 20 times.
Repeat for another 40 ml.
Mix and stir gently the solution, adding PA buffer to reach a total volume of 90 ml.
Transfer 15 ml of the solution into six 50 ml tubes.
Centrifuge at 440 × g for 3 minutes in a TS-38N rotor.
Recover 10 ml of the supernatant.
Add PA buffer to sediment fraction up to 15 ml and mix well.
Centrifuge at 440 × g for 3 minutes.
Recover another 10 ml of the supernatant.
Gently lay a mixture of the solution recovered in step 9 onto four 50 ml tubes containing 10 ml PA storage buffer.
Centrifuge at 1,750 × g for 20 minutes in a TS-38N rotor.
Carefully remove the supernatant by pipetting.
Resuspend the slightly white band of PA chromosomes (formed between supernatant and storage buffer) into the storage buffer using a cut tip.
Store the PA chromosomes at -20 °C until use.
Take 10 ml of PA storage buffer containing PA chromosomes and place in a Dounce homogenizer.
Add 10 ml of Percoll buffer to the homogenizer.
Homogenize gently for 10 times.
Add another 15 ml of Percoll buffer to the mixture.
Gently homogenize the sample slowly for 30 times.
Transfer the homogenized mixture into a centrifuge tube.
Repeat the process for an additional 30 ml of PA storage buffer containing PA chromosomes.
Centrifuge the mixture at 20,000 rpm for 30 minutes in a JA-20 rotor.
Recover approximately 7 to 8 ml of the chromosome fraction from each tube.
Dilute the recovered fraction more than three-fold in wash buffer.
Gently layer the diluted solution onto two 50 ml tubes containing 2 ml of PG storage buffer.
Centrifuge at 2,000 × g for 20 minutes in a TS-38N rotor.
Roughly remove the supernatant by pipetting and dilute the PG chromosome fraction more than three-fold in XBE2.
Layer the solution onto one 50 ml tube containing 2 ml of PG storage buffer.
Centrifuge at 2,000 × g for 20 minutes.
Carefully remove the supernatant by pipetting.
Resuspend the PG chromosomes into storage buffer using a cut tip.
Add one tenth volume of 8% PFA/XBE2 to the PG storage buffer containing PG chromosomes.
Stand for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Dilute the fixed chromosome solution with XBE2.
Add the same volume of 60% sucrose/XBE2 to the fixed chromosome solution.
Place 150 μl of the solution into Cytofunnels set on glassslides.
Spin the samples at 2,000 rpm for 15 minutes with middle acceleration.
Treat specimens in 0.5 mg/ml NaBH4 in XBE2 for 5 minutes.
Wash the glassslides twice for 5 minutes each with XBE2.
Treat specimens in 0.5% Triton X-100/XBE2 for 5 minutes.
Wash the glassslides twice for 5 minutes each with XBE2.
Treat specimens in 3% BSA/XBE2 for 30 minutes.
Remove the blocking solution by tilting glassslides.
Treat specimens in the primary antibody solution diluted in 0.05% Tween 20/XBE2 with 1% BSA for 1 hour.
Wash the glassslides three times for 5 minutes each with XBE2.
Treat specimens in the secondary antibody solution diluted in 0.05% Tween 20/XBE2 with 1% BSA for 1 hour.
Wash the glassslides three times for 5 minutes each with XBE2.
Mount specimens in 1 μg/ml DAPI/Vectashield.
Seal coverslips with nail-polish.
